Thanks again for the sync today. Per our MAP, attaching a concise snapshot of the sizing conversation and the ask we verbally aligned on. This thread will track weekly checkpoint items and owners so we can lock a close timeline.

Summary (requested by CardioAI):
- Target evaluation window: Sept 1 – Sept 21 (3 weeks)
- Initial production target: 50 RPS sustained at 512 tokens (95th pctl latency target: < 300ms)
- Fallback steady-state target after Q4 optimization: 120 RPS

Current proposed dedicated/private inventory (initial commit for evaluation + limited production):
- Region: us-west-2 primary; eu-west-1 optional second region (on-need)
- GPU types / counts (initial):
  - 8x A100 80GB (dedicated pool) — primary serving for eval 
  - 4x H100 80GB (burst/throughput experiments) — optional depending on cost/availability
  - 2x T4 for lightweight embedding/async jobs (private)
- Expected baseline throughput: ~45–60 RPS with A100 80GB (model: resizable-instruct-v1 quant-8), up to 110–130 RPS with H100 mixed config during burst windows

1) CardioAI acceptance of us-west-2 as primary (eu footprint ask: how critical is eu at eval start?)
2) Procurement timeline / PO trigger date for reserved capacity (Laura)
3) Any strict data residency or network requirements for the private deployment (VPC peering, IP allowlists)

- Availability: A100 80GB capacity in us-west-2 is available for a Sept reserved start but requires a firm commit by Aug 20 to guarantee the mix. H100s are constrained in our partner zones; we can reserve 2 H100s for experimentation but scale to 4 only if preliminary perf supports it.

- Recommended starter config (to meet 50 RPS target with headroom):
  - 6x A100 80GB (primary pool)
  - 2x H100 80GB (burst/testing, optional)
  - 2x T4 (embedding/async)
  - Autoscale policy: keep base pool active (A100) + burst pool for controlled tests; target CPU/network provisioning for 50–60 RPS baseline

- Expected perf numbers (rough):
  - 6x A100: ~48–62 RPS sustained (95th pctl < 320ms)
  - +2 H100: burst to ~100–120 RPS (95th pctl varies)
